contact_sources.quote: Chief Investment Officer Alyx Wood Alyx is the Chief Investment Officer of Kernow Asset Management. He is responsible for trading and investment research. Before co-founding Kernow, Alyx worked as a Fund Manager at Downing LLP, Vice President at Deutsche Bank AG, and Management Consultant at KPMG LLP. He is a consultant for several family offices and has completed the Non-Executive Directors Programme (BVCA). Alyx is a Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAS) and holds an Investment Management Certificate (CFA Institute) and a BA in Accounting and Economics. alyx@kernowam.com
